item.title: Why your software development lifecycle is slow
item.description: AI cut the time it takes to write code, but most software development lifecycles were built for a different bottleneck, and closing that gap takes more than swapping in new tools. Traditional software development lifecycles (SDLC) were designed around how fast people could type and coordinate. Sprints, manual quality gates, and review handoffs made sense when writing code was the slowest part of the job. With AI, developers can write, refactor, and document code faster than they could two years ago. What has not moved nearly as much is how fast the same organizations actually ship....

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Tell British Lawmakers: Regulate Us
item.description: AI leaders joined whistleblowers and security leaders at a sweeping parliamentary session, while a few hundred meters away Britain’s spy chief warned AI could be used to create new bioweapons.

item.title: Anthropic apparently offering $190,000 for an executive assistant, despite agentic AI advances
item.description: The leading agentic AI developer recently listed a job opening for a ‘highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-starting’ assistant in its London office. Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic reportedly offered a salary of 145,000 euros (roughly equal to $190,000) for a personal assistant in its London office.

item.title: Mars : la France embarque dans quelques jours dans une aventure spatiale extraordinaire pour explorer un monde encore inconnu
item.description: Aucune sonde ne s'est encore posée sur Phobos, une des deux lunes de Mars. La mission japonaise MMX, dont le lancement est prévu dans quelques jours, tentera l'exploit et devrait rapporter sur Terre les premiers échantillons de cette lune de Mars. On vous explique tout.
